plain: To treat people cruelly, especially for their beliefs

webster.text: In a general sense, to pursue in a manner to injure, vex or afflict; to harass with unjust punishment or penalties for supposed offenses; to inflict pain from hatred or malignity.

example.quote: A test would enable the prevailing sect to persecute the rest.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. SPAIGHT, July 30, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
